schema:
CREATE TABLE "event" ("event_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "venue" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE "entry" ("event_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "participant_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempt_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "finish_code" TEXT, PRIMARY KEY ("event_id", "participant_id", "attempt_no"), FOREIGN KEY ("event_id") REFERENCES "event" ("event_id"));
correct_query: SELECT T2.venue FROM entry AS T1 INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.event_id WHERE T1.finish_code = 'B-200'
